race.description: Melbourne Cup At Callaghan Park Mdn Hcp
race.comment: VAREJAO (15) is the top pick on the strength of his overall maiden profile, with eight placings from 13 starts and a solid record around 1100m. His latest fourth at Sunshine Coast came in provincial company on soft ground and he had some width to contend with, so this looks a suitable chance to break through third-up. GROENING (6) has less exposed form but improved sharply at Sunshine Coast when making ground from well back after covering ground, and the third-up profile gives him scope to take another step. WAVE DANCER (8) is hard to ignore for consistency, having placed five times from nine starts and resumed with a Mackay second as favourite. Include. PULSATING (7) has been runner-up at her past two and suited around 1100m, but beaten as odds-on favourite last time. Can give this a shake on best.
